title: Seek out Brother Tosai
wikitext:
{{Quest infobox | name = Seek out Brother Tosai | map = | campaign = Factions | region = Kaineng City | type = Secondary | given by = [[Bujo]] or [[Ke Feng]] / [[Senjo Wah]] | given at = [[Kaineng Center]] or [[The Undercity]] | preceded by = [[The Search for a Cure]] | followed by = [[Refuse to Drink]] or
[[Drink from the Chalice of Corruption]]}} This quest is a part of a secondary quest line, and is good for getting extra [[experience]]. The basis for this quest is to continue the undercover investigation you are asked to do on behalf of the Emperor. The plague referred to earlier in the game time-line by [[Master Togo]] plays a background part to this quest, in that you get the chance to experience the plague first hand. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== *Speak with [[Brother Tosai]] ===Reward=== * 3,000 [[Experience]] * 175 [[Gold]] ===Environmental changes=== * While this quest is active, all the [[Am Fah]] in [[Wajjun Bazaar]] will be [[Ally|allies]]. This also means that they will not ambush parties out near the areas closer to [[Nahpui Quarter (outpost)|Nahpui Quarter]]. Because of this, it may be advantageous to hold off on completing this until you finish your quests in [[The Undercity]] and/or [[Vanquisher|vanquish]] Wajjun Bazaar. The exceptions to this are the quests [[Captured]], [[The Xunlai Agent]], [[Deactivating P.O.X.]], and [[Street Justice]]. The Am Fah in the immediate area will still be hostile. * After completing this quest, all the Am Fah will be allies until you take either [[Refuse to Drink]] or [[Drink from the Chalice of Corruption]]. You can use this advantage and keep the [[Chalice of Corruption]] in the inventory for some time, while doing other quests in Wajjun Bazaar and nearby areas. ==Walkthrough== Just speak with Brother Tosai. You can find him near the entrance to The Undercity surrounded by legions of Am Fah. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== '''Bujo''', '''Ke Feng''' or '''Senjo Wah''' :''"These weaklings who bow to their simpering emperor all fear the plague. Idiots, every one of them! This...sickness is a gift from the gods! Only those who are truly strong may thrive in its loving embrace. If you would become such a person and a true member of the '''Am Fah''', you should seek out '''Brother Tosai'''."'' :''"Have you the strength to look death in the eye?"'' {{offer dialog |accept = I have the strength. |decline = My eyesight is poor. I think I'll skip this. |ask = If you are no coward, go speak with '''Brother Tosai'''. You will find him near the entrance to '''the Undercity'''. |indent = :: }} ===Reward dialogue=== '''Brother Tosai''' :'' "Bujo has sent you, you say? You must have impressed him... If you are indeed worthy of joining our ranks and gaining immeasurable strength, you must take the Chalice of Corruption and drink deeply of its bounty."'' ==Notes== *If you take the [[Refuse to Drink]] quest that follows, you will immediately be attacked by the Am Fah there, and Brother Tosai. *As mentioned above, leaving this quest in the [[Quest Log]] without finishing it, allows to do other quests in the zone without enemies, since the [[Am Fah]] foes are allies. This is a good way to grind [[experience]] to level up since there are many quests in that zone that give 3,000 XP rewards. It also makes [[vanquish]]ing easier. {{bug|Sometimes this quest does not show in the quest log.}} [[Category:Quests useful for farming]]
